correctness.rationale: Exact polygon-edge convex-hull boundary decomposition gives the chord formula on the exponentially likely side-coverage event; joint empty-small-arc probabilities give 2m independent exponential limits; exponential tails give all fixed moment convergence; gamma-ratio integration produces the explicit Laplace and mean; endpoint linearization and convolution give the small tail; mgf finiteness threshold plus Laplace factor division reconstructs the turning-angle multiset. Finite checks compared 4800 independent convex-hull perimeters with the exact corner sum and tested analytical integrals. No simulations are used to prove asymptotics.

originality.rationale: Compared same-sampling full-text primary literature (arXiv:1103.4978, 1911.05917, 2404.02870) and semantic research-record queries under functional/alias/angle parameters. Prior V1 results provide general order bounds, polytope results cover missing volume and facets, and the closest planar result covers Hausdorff distance. The new nonlinear independent-corner perimeter-law, exact mean and small-tail order, and angle-tomography mgf factorization were not covered by inspected statements. Priority remains provisional; failed search is not conclusive proof.

value.rationale: Provides the full distribution, explicit mean and sharp lower-tail exponent for first-order perimeter approximation of any fixed convex polygon, and proves an angle-tomography inverse theorem together with sharp nonidentifiability of side lengths (equal-perimeter rectangles). This is a structural improvement beyond a rate estimate or a single special-case computation, with natural use in geometric approximation and inverse shape statistics.
